reviews.text:
After contacting and speaking with Jorge, we couldn't be more grateful. From the very first contact and the guidelines he gave us, we noticed a remarkable change in Mocca.
Hiring his services was absolutely the right decision! Our Labrador puppy is a bit of a whirlwind and quite anxious! And now he behaves so much better! We've also learned countless games and strategies to help him tolerate his frustration and learn how to socialize. We just want to say a thousand thanks to Jorge! He's an incredible professional!

The experience has been fantastic in many ways, both with Jorge and Miguel. From the very beginning, they taught us how to work with our dog (Gala), creating a solid foundation of obedience while simultaneously building an increasingly strong bond with her. Beyond their professionalism, it's clear from their interactions with us that they adore dogs. Something very important to me is that they don't just work with the dog; they've also motivated us to reinforce and practice what they taught us in the classes every day, helping us understand that with desire and dedication, results always come.

Meeting Jorge and working with Eros has been the best thing for him. He's helped us improve Eros's separation anxiety, which he now controls very well, and we can finally go for walks with him without him barking the whole time and enjoy the walk. I recommend him 100%. He explains everything perfectly, with a lot of patience, and above all, he takes his time and is always there for any questions. He answers right away. Thank you so much, Jorge, and if you need help with your dogs, call me. You won't regret it.

We are very satisfied with Miguel, who guided us brilliantly throughout all phases of the training and kept a close eye on the animal's progress.
Congratulations on your great work!
A very good experience with Educan, very friendly and professional service, special mention to Jorge, we would definitely recommend them

Although we had tried other trainers, and although the experiences were positive, they never reached the level of results we expected. With Jorge, however, we definitely feel that the sessions have paid off and our dogs' handling has improved. I would recommend him to anyone.

We were so lucky to find them; our vet recommended them, and it was a great decision.
Our dog, Bella, was extremely fearful and insecure, which caused her to bark at everything in the street. At home, we had some very difficult situations that made living together very challenging. Thanks to the whole team, and especially to Jorge, who helped us understand her, manage the situation, and enjoy her company.
They also have a boarding facility, a wonderful place where dogs are very happy and cared for with great affection.

My Labrador, Stark, is an adorable little dog 🐶 but he's a bit crazy 🤯 and sometimes gets overly excited when he shouldn't. 😵‍💫 We called Educan and they told us about their training programs. Jorge has been teaching us the guidelines and has made Stark much more obedient. 👏👏👏 We are very grateful for his patience and how well he understands dogs. He's wonderful, highly recommended. 🥰 If you have a dog with a strong personality and want a change, don't hesitate to contact Educan. 🙏

I found out about the company through a friend's recommendation and I've been delighted with the work they do, especially with the trainer Miguel. He's very committed, understanding, and overall I'm extremely grateful. It was a great decision!

We're thrilled with the experience! We've finished our training and are delighted with the results. Miguel has been wonderful from the start, empathetic and helpful in every way possible, patiently handling Ratón and winning him over, which isn't always easy. We've achieved the changes we wanted when we hired the service, and we felt very supported throughout the process. We can only say thank you!

A very good experience. Miguel is a great professional, very patient and empathetic. In a very short time, my dog ​​went from not wanting to go outside and being scared of everything, to the complete opposite (she wants to go outside, noises no longer frighten her...). Furthermore, the follow-up is very attentive, and they answer any questions that arise during the time you're working with your pet, following the guidelines you provide. They also give you all the practiced guidelines in writing, as well as videos of them, to make it much easier.
Very professional, with them I was able to rehabilitate a hairy little creature with many traumas and difficulties

The best service in the world with amazing professionals. My trainer taught us with genuine passion, cared deeply about our progress, and answered all our questions whenever we needed help. She's made my puppy happy during training because of the motivation and enthusiasm she conveys. I highly recommend taking the courses; they're well worth it, and you'll see fantastic results in a short time for keeping our dogs active.
Macarena is amazing! Our dog Coco's condition improved dramatically thanks to her training and advice. We are so grateful!
